item.title: Applying Optimization: Some Samples
item.description: Lecture presentation on linear optimization, min-max optimization, dynamic programming, and Lagrange multipliers.

item.title: Basic Physics of Underwater Acoustics
item.description: Lecture presentation on the basic physics of underwater acoustics.

item.title: Concepts of Design
item.description: Lecture presentation on the concepts of design, tradeoffs, the objectives tree, decision matrices, knowledge versus confidence, function analysis, complexity, and Gantt charts.

item.title: Design for the Ocean Environment
item.description: Lecture presentation on design for the ocean environment, waves, categories of vehicles, and aerodynamics.

item.title: Electronics Essentials
item.description: Lecture presentation on electronics, the op-amp, serial communications, pulse width modulation (PWM), field effect transistor (FET), and motors.

item.title: Experiments, Tests, and Data
item.description: Lecture presentation on experiments, tests, data, controls, calibration, and statistics.

item.title: Feedback Control
item.description: Lecture presentation on feedback control and the components of engineered feedback systems.

item.title: Feedback Control System Design
item.description: Lecture presentation on feedback control system design, types of control systems, open and closed loop control systems, and state-space models.

item.title: Introduction to Discrete-Time Systems
item.description: Lecture presentation on discrete-time systems and time resolution in sampled systems.
